newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 26.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Front page editorial and report hail regional cooperation after meeting of Asian-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in the Philippines, with text of speech by President Jiang Zemin to the forum.
Premier Li Peng tells central government departments to set an example in the campaign to build spiritual civilisation.
Chinese customs officials achieve great results in war on narcotics, seizing a total of more than 1.5 tonnes of all kinds of illegal drugs since 1989.
Head of the People's Bank of China, Dai Xianglong, says foreign direct investment in China expected to reach $40 billion in 1996.
Foreign Minister Qian Qichen predicts meeting of APEC forum to provide a shot in the arm for regional economic growth.
China completes first nationwide registration of the property rights of government administrative institutions, aiming to curb loss of state assets.
